source_scope: Creature/species design directions supplied by user plus canonical Pillar/Aspect and combat boundary references; concept entries are not full executable stat blocks.

entries.name: Firebound Sentry

physiology_notes: Standard human physiology; Vigor36 and Armor3 in independently authored fixture.

planned_capabilities.name: Sword plus reserved Conjure Flame
planned_capabilities.concept: B06-AT-01/02 existing fully specified one-attack weapon physical and Fire/Vigor packets; no invented fire Exaltation.

open_mechanics: Opposed encounter log and difficulty calibration remain open.
entries.lore_boundary: An authored humanoid combatant, not evidence that ordinary humans inherently invoke the Veil.

entries.name: Ordinary Human Soldier

physiology_notes: Uses Vigor as an ordinary human; no innate spell access.
behavior_notes: Individual training and culture vary; cannot be assumed to follow one universal tactic.

planned_capabilities.name: Ordinary trained weapon strike
planned_capabilities.concept: Use existing sword/mace/spear profiles once Training, Abilities, equipment and legitimate action economy are defined.
missing_authority: Explicit NPC non-Archetype AP/Tempo/Guard/Vigor baseline and exact equipped profile

planned_capabilities.name: Optional acquired magical item
planned_capabilities.concept: May use an actual authored item's independent effects; item ownership does not make its wielder a Veil invoker.
missing_authority: Individual item stats, activation mode, item-provided source power and VP requirement

open_mechanics: Non-Archetype human Turn AP/Tempo and progression, attack/defense stats and legal talents; no automatic Projection or spell VP.
entries.lore_boundary: Ordinary humans have Vigor and a relationship to the Veil but cannot themselves invoke Veil techniques; learned Archetypes are exceptional, not universal.

entries.name: Hunter of the Woods

physiology_notes: Larger and bulkier than a bear; wolf-like head; a horn; venomous bite.
behavior_notes: Predatory animal instincts; exact intelligence, sociality and hunting tactics await creature authoring.

planned_capabilities.name: Venomous bite
planned_capabilities.concept: Puncturing bite may deliver a separately selected fictional TX catalogue profile after true surviving puncture; no toxin route from merely naming venom.
missing_authority: Natural bite Attack/Defense/AP, puncture damage, source and selected TX profile; independently authorized venom delivery

planned_capabilities.name: Horn strike
planned_capabilities.concept: A physical horn attack; does not inherit bite venom.
missing_authority: Natural horn attack roll/AP/damage/trauma

planned_capabilities.name: Claw or body strike
planned_capabilities.concept: Alternative natural physical attack, no free attack sequence.
missing_authority: Actual anatomy and natural attack action profile

open_mechanics: Large body/size rules, reach, attack cadence, bite puncture and toxin source, HP/Vigor, Guard/Dodge limitations.
entries.lore_boundary: Not a humanoid, Priest or Gifted; no implied learnable spells, psychic control or attack bonus from its ominous name.

entries.name: Veil-touched Dire Giant Spider

physiology_notes: Unusually large aggressive spider; actual body dimensions, venom, web and armor undecided.
behavior_notes: Aggressive predatory behavior; no sapient plans assumed.

planned_capabilities.name: Spider bite
planned_capabilities.concept: Basic physical bite. Whether venom applies is separately authored; no generic spider poison.
missing_authority: Spider bite roll/AP/damage; decision on venom-bearing physiology and specific exposure source

planned_capabilities.name: Veil-touched expression
planned_capabilities.concept: Specific physiological or supernatural alteration to be selected; the Veil-touched label alone grants nothing.
missing_authority: What changed, associated Pillar if any, paid or limited resource, delivery and defenses

open_mechanics: Nature of Veil alteration; possible web behavior; natural body/action and special effect math.
entries.lore_boundary: Veil-touched denotes an origin/alteration, not a free attack, spell list or mandatory magic venom.

entries.name: Goblin — Inward-focused

physiology_notes: Innate inward-dominant Veil integration; comparatively high Vigor and regeneration, numerical amounts unknown.
behavior_notes: Individual personality and cultures vary. No universal goblin disposition.

planned_capabilities.name: Physical combat
planned_capabilities.concept: Ordinary or personally trained weapons supported when NPC statistics are authored; no Projection or castable spells.
missing_authority: Species Vigor and regeneration benchmarks
Weapon Training/AP and equipment

open_mechanics: Inward integration numeric scale; whether any innate non-projective abilities need additional rules.
entries.lore_boundary: No species-level automatic spell Projection or spellcasting; do not imply shared psychology or culture.

entries.name: Orc — Inward-focused

physiology_notes: High Vigor and regeneration from inward Veil integration; larger forms may have leathery natural skin. Not uniform across individuals.
behavior_notes: Orc motivations and culture are not determined by biological traits.

planned_capabilities.name: Physical combat
planned_capabilities.concept: Weapon/ordinary physical attacks; no independent Projection or castable spells.
missing_authority: Source-backed non-Archetype action/AP/Training

planned_capabilities.name: Possible natural skin protection
planned_capabilities.concept: Some larger forms may have thick leathery skin; natural Armor is not automatically additive to worn equipment.
missing_authority: Size applicability and Armor stacking/coverage interaction

open_mechanics: Vigor and regeneration quantitative physiology; injury and wound interaction; whether skin Armor is additive or alternative.
entries.lore_boundary: Orcs are not inherently aggressive or culturally uniform; innate inward integration is not Priest-style spellcasting.

entries.name: Elf — Outward-focused

physiology_notes: Ultra-outward Veil integration; almost no inward reinforcement; extremely limited Vigor and bodily fragility, magnitudes unauthored.
behavior_notes: Population isolated and driven away by humans in the user's setting direction; neither disposition nor cultural uniformity is inferred.

planned_capabilities.name: Outward Veil expression
planned_capabilities.concept: Exceptional outward Veil capability, but no automatic player High Focus, prepared spells or free spellcasting.
missing_authority: Exact outward expression/ability, cost and defense, low-Vigor formula or override

open_mechanics: Numerical almost-zero Vigor floor, physiological survival rules and whether healing/Regeneration differ.
Specific access mechanism for outward power without importing an entire High Focus progression.
entries.lore_boundary: High outward connection is a physiology/metaphysics direction, not a universal wizard identity; no elf playable MVP.

entries.name: Dwarf — Unresolved
open_mechanics: Species physiology, Veil relationship, cognition, environmental adaptation, cultures and combat identity deliberately TBD.
entries.lore_boundary: No implicit short-stature, craft affinity, underground living or fixed demeanor imported from other fantasy settings.

entries.name: Dragon — Non-spellcasting

physiology_notes: Flying, natural weapons and breath attack; size/physiology per dragon variety undecided.
behavior_notes: Intelligence approximately canine or modestly above; instinctively expresses connected Pillar's principles; not a spellcasting strategist.

planned_capabilities.name: Breath attack
planned_capabilities.concept: One species-authored breath attack; not necessarily Fire and not an ordinary spell/Projection.
missing_authority: Breath source, Pillar/element if any, area geometry, cooldown/resource, mitigation and defense

planned_capabilities.name: Flight
planned_capabilities.concept: Dragon can fly in lore; flying combat is outside B06-A.
missing_authority: Flight, airborne movement/position, interruption and range

planned_capabilities.name: Natural weapon attacks
planned_capabilities.concept: Bites/claws/tail only where bodily and mechanically authored, not automatic multiple attacks.
missing_authority: Natural attack cadence, size/reach, Armor/Penetration

open_mechanics: Detailed flight, size/scale and breath area mechanics are deferred; Pillar instinct must not grant actual learned Veil spells.
entries.lore_boundary: Mostly nonsapient creature's instinctive Pillar alignment does not itself generate voluntary Pillar fuel or Anointed Mission.

entries.name: Raised Skeleton

physiology_notes: Existing corpse/bones animated into a physical undead; exact Vigor, HP, poison and repair physiology not yet authored.
behavior_notes: Commands and autonomy depend on the authored animation, not on a universal mindless-undead template.

planned_capabilities.name: Physical weapon attack
planned_capabilities.concept: Potential physical attack with wielded weapon if the animation actually supports wielding and AP/Training.
missing_authority: Corporeal undead body action rules, Attack/Defense and damage baseline

open_mechanics: What sustains animation; HP/Vigor/Dying, wounds/repair, resistance to mundane toxin and physical/Veil defenses.
entries.lore_boundary: Death/Mastery reanimates an existing body; this is not an independent Death/Spirit apparition or free resurrection.

entries.name: Turned Vampire

physiology_notes: Transformed individual, not automatically a raised corpse; retained biological functions and durability unresolved.
behavior_notes: May retain identity and personal history; behavior/culture not predetermined.

planned_capabilities.name: Turned nature
planned_capabilities.concept: Signature physiological powers and limitations need independent authored rules; no generic hypnosis, regeneration or sunlight weakness.
missing_authority: State/afflictions, physiological costs, attack and transformation mechanics

open_mechanics: Turned-state resource rules, strengths, weaknesses and transformation origin not specified.
entries.lore_boundary: Turned undead are distinct from raised undead; no lore-derived immunity package or common moral alignment.

entries.name: Turned Lich

physiology_notes: Turned undead individual; exact physical/Veil durability not specified.
behavior_notes: Personality, retained knowledge and spell access depend on individual history and authored transformation.

planned_capabilities.name: Potential learned Veil capabilities
planned_capabilities.concept: If a lich knows magic from actual earlier learning, retain only lawfully authored capabilities; undeath alone is not a free full spell repertoire.
missing_authority: Transformation source, retained ability access/VP and physiology

open_mechanics: Turned transformation source and resource continuity, phylactery-like assumptions explicitly not imported.
entries.lore_boundary: Do not assume every lich is a conventional wizard or possesses a phylactery.

entries.name: Pillar Surge Manifestation

physiology_notes: Coalesced Veil pattern that may be fleeting, anchored, or persistent; corporeality and durability depend on individual authoring.
behavior_notes: Non-sentient behavior follows the source Pillar/Aspect pattern and event conditions, not orders, judgments or independent morality.

planned_capabilities.name: Pattern-bound expression
planned_capabilities.concept: Non-sapient effect from a Pillar surge. Not an Anointed, independent spirit, deity, angel or demon.
missing_authority: Surge formation rules; Pillar/Aspect source; trigger/cadence; energy budget; target and manifestation/physical interaction rules

open_mechanics: Formation probability, anchor/sustain/expiry, physical attack eligibility and dissolution mechanics undecided.
entries.lore_boundary: Potential consequence of a surge, not guaranteed; original collective volition can create the surge but the nonsapient manifestation does not itself contribute renewed voluntary Pillar fuel.

entries.name: Independent Posthumous Spirit

physiology_notes: Nonphysical fleeting presence in the Veil; not an automatically tangible combat target.
behavior_notes: Spirit communication/summoning belongs to Death/Spirit, distinct from raised/turned undead.

planned_capabilities.name: Fleeting summoned appearance
planned_capabilities.concept: Not physically interacting with ordinary material combat; requires separately authored Death/Spirit interaction mechanics.
missing_authority: Spirit technique and actual summoning permissions

open_mechanics: Conditions for spirits, perception and communication, but no B06 ordinary melee attack/targeting.
entries.lore_boundary: Do not convert this entry into an incorporeal melee monster, raised undead body or physical damage target.
